places.name: Genipabu Dune Buggies (Natal)
places.ai_summary: Genipabu is famous for its expansive sand dunes, where visitors can enjoy thrilling buggy rides and camel tours. The area also offers stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary depending on weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Opt for the ‘with emotion’ buggy ride for an adrenaline rush.
places.address: Genipabu, Natal - RN, Brazil

places.name: Fortaleza Beachfront (Beira Mar)
places.ai_summary: Beira Mar is the bustling beachfront area of Fortaleza, featuring a lively promenade, local markets, and stunning ocean views. It’s perfect for a leisurely stroll or a sunset view.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the evening for the local market.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood dishes at the nearby restaurants.
places.address: Beira Mar, Fortaleza - CE, Brazil

places.name: Canoa Quebrada Cliffs
places.ai_summary: Canoa Quebrada is a picturesque beach destination known for its dramatic red cliffs, vibrant nightlife, and laid-back atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the evening for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Take a buggy ride to explore the cliffs and nearby beaches.
places.address: Canoa Quebrada, Aracati - CE, Brazil

places.name: Jericoacoara National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park known for its dunes, lagoons, and the famous Pedra Furada rock formation. It's a paradise for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season (July to December).

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the sunset at the Duna do Por do Sol.
places.address: Jericoacoara, Jijoca de Jericoacoara - CE, Brazil

places.name: Morro Branco Beach Canyons
places.ai_summary: Famous for its stunning cliffs and canyons, Morro Branco is a great place for hiking and exploring natural beauty. The beach is also known for its colorful handicrafts market.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for hiking.

places.place_tip: Visit the handicraft market for local souvenirs.
places.address: Morro Branco, Beberibe - CE, Brazil

places.name: Praia do Futuro (Fortaleza)
places.ai_summary: A popular city beach in Fortaleza, known for its wide stretch of sand, beach clubs, and vibrant atmosphere. It's ideal for sunbathing, swimming, and enjoying local cuisine.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the crab dishes at the beachside kiosks.
places.address: Praia do Futuro, Fortaleza - CE, Brazil

places.name: Natal Historic Center
places.ai_summary: The historic heart of Natal, featuring colonial architecture, museums, and the famous Forte dos Reis Magos. It's a great place to learn about the city's history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit the Museu Câmara Cascudo for local history.
places.address: Centro Histórico, Natal - RN, Brazil

places.name: Parrachos de Maracajaú Reef Snorkeling
places.ai_summary: A stunning coral reef located near Natal, perfect for snorkeling and diving. The clear waters and rich marine life make it a top attraction for underwater enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during low tide.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear to save on rental costs.
places.address: Maracajaú, Maxaranguape - RN, Brazil

places.name: São Miguel do Gostoso Kitesurfing
places.ai_summary: São Miguel do Gostoso is a renowned kitesurfing destination, offering ideal wind conditions and beautiful beaches. It's a must-visit for water sports enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the kitesurfing season (September to April).

places.place_tip: Take a lesson if you're a beginner.
places.address: São Miguel do Gostoso, RN, Brazil

places.name: Ponte dos Ingleses Sunset
places.ai_summary: A popular spot to watch the sunset in Fortaleza, offering stunning views of the coastline and the city. It's a romantic and picturesque location.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the beautiful sunset.
places.address: Ponte dos Ingleses, Fortaleza - CE, Brazil

places.place_tip: Attend a film screening or art exhibition.

places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for local handicrafts.

places.name: Cumbuco Beach Sand Dunes
places.ai_summary: Cumbuco is known for its stunning sand dunes and lagoons, offering a range of activities from dune buggy rides to kitesurfing. The beach is also famous for its vibrant nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season (August to December).

places.place_tip: Experience the sunset at the dunes for a breathtaking view.
places.address: Cumbuco, Caucaia - CE, Brazil

places.name: Praia das Fontes
places.ai_summary: A beautiful beach known for its natural springs and stunning cliffs. It's a great spot for relaxation and enjoying nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Explore the cliffs and natural springs.
places.address: Praia das Fontes, Beberibe - CE, Brazil

places.name: Parque das Dunas (Natal)
places.ai_summary: A large urban park in Natal, featuring dunes, trails, and a wide variety of plant and animal life. It's a great place for hiking, picnicking, and enjoying nature.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for a picnic.
places.address: Parque das Dunas, Natal - RN, Brazil

places.name: Fortaleza Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A beautiful cathedral located in the heart of Fortaleza, known for its impressive architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass and event schedules.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass for a local experience.
places.address: Catedral Metropolitana, Fortaleza - CE, Brazil

places.name: Beach Park Water Resort
places.ai_summary: One of the largest water parks in Latin America, featuring a wide variety of water slides, pools, and attractions. It's a perfect family-friendly destination.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for special events and promotions.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to enjoy all the attractions.
places.address: Beach Park, Aquiraz - CE, Brazil

places.name: Cachoeira de Missão Velha
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located in a serene environment, perfect for relaxation and enjoying nature. The area also offers hiking trails and picnic spots.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the rainy season (January to July).

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for a picnic.
places.address: Missão Velha, CE, Brazil

places.name: Pirangi Cashew Tree (Largest in World)
places.ai_summary: Home to the largest cashew tree in the world, this park offers a unique opportunity to see this amazing tree and enjoy the surrounding nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season (August to December).

places.place_tip: Try the local cashew products.
places.address: Pirangi do Norte, Parnamirim - RN, Brazil

places.name: Pipa Beach Dolphins
places.ai_summary: Praia da Pipa is not only famous for its stunning beach but also for the dolphins that can be seen swimming in the bay. It's a great spot for dolphin watching and enjoying the beach.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dolphin watching season (June to September).

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour for the best dolphin viewing experience.
places.address: Praia da Pipa, Tibau do Sul - RN, Brazil
